content.text: Creators in Nigeria face significant barriers when it comes to using popular [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-4|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal. With Stripe operating in only 46 out of 195 countries, many digital entrepreneurs are excluded from the global marketplace. This leaves them searching for reliable alternatives that can enable them to sell digital products effectively without the risk of account suspensions or withheld funds.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stripe alternatives

[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-13|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure is a new paradigm for digital creators in regions facing payment platform restrictions. Traditional services often exclude countries based on their risk assessments. This can leave creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and similar markets without viable options. By leveraging infrastructure that prioritizes ownership and autonomy, creators can bypass these limitations and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-selling-digital-downloads-pakistan-until-you-read|COREMERCH guide to build]] robust online stores that are resistant to external restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure utilizes a combination of free and paid tools to create a seamless selling experience. For instance, platforms like Cloudflare Pages and Workers provide the necessary hosting and backend services, while NOWPayments integrates crypto payment processing. This stack operates independently of major players like Stripe or PayPal, meaning creators maintain full control over their data and transactions. The architecture is designed for efficiency and reliability, ensuring that creators can launch their stores with minimal barriers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is primarily aimed at digital creators in countries where traditional payment processors are unavailable or problematic. Whether you're selling ebooks, online courses, or digital assets, the sovereign commerce infrastructure equips you with the tools you need to operate independently. It’s built for individuals who value ownership and seek to establish a stable online presence without the risk of being locked out of their accounts due to geographical restrictions.
Take ownership of your digital commerce with sovereign infrastructure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack is composed of several key components that seamlessly integrate to provide a comprehensive solution. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting environment, while Google Sheets or Supabase store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is used for file delivery, and NOWPayments handles crypto transactions, enabling creators to receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. This structure allows for low-cost operations and ensures that creators retain complete ownership of their infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select the appropriate stack that fits your needs. For instance, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a robust option that will be deployed in just 48 hours. Follow the setup instructions provided in the documentation to configure your hosting, payment processing, and product delivery. Finally, test your store thoroughly to ensure everything functions correctly before launching. You can find the required tools and templates at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, you can still sell digital products by utilizing sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach allows you to host your store on platforms like Cloudflare Pages and accept payments via crypto using NOWPayments. This way, you maintain full control over your operations without relying on restricted payment processors.
No more account lockouts or suspended funds—just seamless transactions.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those searching for effective alternatives to platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers an ideal solution. This stack is designed specifically for creators facing payment restrictions, providing a direct path to launching a fully operational online store.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
